turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to stop buying coffee every morning and make it at home instead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good plan, you'll save a lot. Do you want something simple like a French press, or are you ready to invest in an espresso machine?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me talk to Grace for a bit, so please stay quiet until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are we still going to your sister's on Saturday?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: She cancelled, the baby's got a cold.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh no, poor thing. So we're free all day then?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Looks like it. We could finally clear out the garage.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or we could not do that and go for a long lunch instead.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Garage in the morning, lunch after. That's my offer.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Decided between the French press and the espresso machine?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Espresso. I mostly drink lattes, so I might as well.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then get one with a steam wand for the milk. It'll pay for itself in a few months.
